---
name: Suggest a change

## The case behind it

A real ask where the current behaviour let you down. Link an existing issue if there is one.

## The change

The smallest change that would fix the case. A changed rule is better than a new one.

## What it costs

- Lines added to `SKILL.md`:
- Does it make forged prompts longer?

## What was already considered

Have you checked the matching decision in `docs/DESIGN.md`? Note anything it says about this idea.
